For Bengaluru-based MomsMade, however, the traditional sweet has become more than a seasonal delicacy. It has turned into the centrepiece of a packaged-snacks business built by a mother-son duo.

articles.title: Bihar Government Increases DA for Employees and Pensioners
articles.summary: Patna, November 12: The Bihar government has granted a significant relief to state employees, pensioners, and family pensioners by approving an increase in Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief (DR). articles.title: Driver shot dead inside home in Patna village; killers flee with cellphone

articles.title: Debrigarh Wildlife Sanctuary’s new striped visitor traced to Chhattisgarh tiger reserve
